name: Aeldari Ranger

bonuses.name: Cameleoline Cloak
bonuses.text: +1 bonus to Stealth (A) Tests (included in SKILLS above) and +1 Defence when using cover.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin

bonuses.name: Deadshot
bonuses.text: When this Threat uses the Aim action and makes a Called Shot they double the bonus ED.

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

bonuses.name: From the Shadows
bonuses.text: Whenever a vision penalty or cover affects someone trying to attack or detect this Threat, the penalty is increased by +2.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 2 personal Ruin, 5 Wounds). Beside Core's Ranger (a different name); its Long Rifle is Sniper (2), this one Sniper (4).
